chunks: Abu al-Sabbah al-Kinani asked him: “How is the badanah to be slaughtered?” He said:
“It is slaughtered while it is standing, from the right side.”

key_terms.أَبُو الصَّبَّاحِ: Abu al-Sabbah, the narrator who asks the question
key_terms.تُنْحَرُ: it is slaughtered by nahr, the prescribed method for camels

ai.seo_question: How should a badanah camel be slaughtered in Islamic law?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on the proper manner of slaughtering a badanah. It states that the camel is to be slaughtered while standing and from the right side, indicating the prescribed method in sacrificial practice.
